question: Where are a garden located within a 190 kilometers range toward the northwest of Spella Park, Algonquin, IL?
sql: WITH SpellaPark AS ( SELECT p.geometry AS geom FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Spella Park%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT r.geometry FROM regions AS r WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Algonquin%' AND r.border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)::geography) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.park_name FROM parks AS p, SpellaPark AS sp WHERE p.leisure = 'garden' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sp.geom::geography, 190 * 1000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(sp.geom), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
